Clients and API

Clients are the applications and services that interact with TaktX. They don’t connect to engine nodes directly—instead, they communicate exclusively via Kafka topics. This approach decouples clients from the engine, making the system more flexible and scalable.

Submitting Commands

To start a process, complete a task, or send an event, a client produces a message to the appropriate Kafka topic. The message format is well-defined, ensuring compatibility and traceability.

Consuming Events

Clients can subscribe to topics to receive updates about process execution, task assignments, and results. This allows for real-time monitoring and integration with external systems. 

API Design

While TaktX’s primary API is Kafka itself, client libraries and SDKs provide higher-level abstractions for common operations, making it easier to integrate with various programming languages and frameworks.
